changes.comment: Add managed Jest sharding and collation with portable validated results, V8/Babel coverage merging, consolidated builtin reports, and coverage thresholds enforced once on the merged map. Protect report ownership with content-bound inventories and capture static coverage inputs outside Jest roots, including verified Babel ignore-file exclusions and cache-hit execution-input evidence. The Heft peer range is stamped from the coupled workspace release that supplies parameter-mode preflight and defaultPluginName.

Classify managed suite failures using completion receipts and supervised workers rather than error wording. Supervise the final worker through reporting and expose the whole-suite passWithNoTests policy. Add opt-in collator-owned JUnit with version 3 assertion details and consolidated JSON, preserving failures and fencing publication/cancellation cleanup.
